title: Quinoa Chickpea Salad

items: 1 cup quinoa ( around 200 grams ) : 2 cups water / vegetable stock

method: Combine the quinoa and water in a pot. bring to a boil, cover, reduce the heat, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove from the heat and let it sit, covered for 10 more minutes.
Soak chickpea overnight then pressure cook for 5-6 whistles
Leave both the quinoa + chickpea to cool well
Cut up your vegetables and set aside till ready to assemble
To make the dressing, add all the ingredients to a bowl and mix together, season to your taste preference
In a bowl add in quinoa, chickpea, vegetables of choice, coriander a crumble of feta and finish with the dressing and enjoy
caption:
Quinoa Chickpea Salad 
simply salads | meal prep | vegan friendly

Nutrition:
C: 58 | F: 17 | P: 18
Calories: 442 per serve 
Makes 5 portions of Salad 

1 cup quinoa ( around 200 grams ) : 2 cups water / vegetable stock
1 cup chickpea ( around 200 grams ) 
2 cucumber, small cubed
1 - 2 onions, sliced + picked in 2 tbsp vinegar 
handful of coriander
handful of mint
crumble of feta ( skip if vegan ) 

Dressing:
1/4 cup olive oil
1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 lemon, juiced
salt + pepper, to taste
2-3 garlic cloves, minced

Method 
how to cook quinoa: 
combine the quinoa and water in a pot. bring to a boil, cover, reduce the heat, and simmer for 15 minutes.
remove from the heat and let it sit, covered for 10 more minutes.
fluff with a fork.

soak chickpea overnight then pressure cook for 5-6 whistles
leave both the quinoa + chickpea to cool well

cut up your vegetables and set aside till ready to assemble 

to make the dressing, add all the ingredients to a bowl and mix together, season to your taste preference
in a bowl add in quinoa, chickpea, vegetables of choice, coriander a crumble of feta and finish with the dressing and enjoy
